name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Pandemics
benefit: - One-time financial assistance in the range of ₹5,000/- to ₹10,000/- (lumpsum) per eligible artist, as decided by the committee. - Released in the Bank Account (Nationalized Bank) of the artist. The disbursement is done in the form of Electronic Clearing Service mode.
_eligibility_text: - The artist must be a resident of Goa. - The artist must be above 18 years of age. - The artist must have lost the source of income due to the pandemic of COVID-19. - The individual income of the artist (from all the sources) must not exceed ₹1,50,000/- per annum. - The artist should be working and contributing in the field of art and culture fields, i.e. Music/Dance/Drama/Tiatr/ Folk/Kir tan/Bhajan/Painting/Sculpture/Literature/Cantarists/Sahittik/Poets/Photographers/traditional Handicraft etc. - Artists should be in need of such financial assistance as contemplated in the scheme. - The artist should solely be dependent on the art related activities/programmes. - The artist shall not be a Government employee or an employee of Autonomous bodies, Corporations nor pensioner of any organization.
